## The journey beyond

Pick one of these to do with your class or friends.

- Use a digital tool to make an animation of cell division, and share it in class.
- Build a model of a synthetic cell from low-cost, eco-friendly material.
- Build a mitosis or meiosis model with classmates. What did teamwork add, and did your idea of division change?
- Write a nukkad natak in simple dialogue about what the organelles do.
